I can usually move through the routine parts of the EHR quickly, but the cumulative burden is still real: too many clicks to document a straightforward follow-up, inbox messages multiplying over minor brace questions, imaging requests, and referral loose ends, and constant small changes that nobody asked for. I end up spending attention on the computer that should be going to the patient sitting in front of me.

What wears me down most is change fatigue. A new digital workflow gets rolled out, training is thin, and suddenly a simple order that worked last week throws an error or routes to the wrong place. I do not need more "innovation" that adds friction. I need reliability, fewer duplicative tasks, and documentation tools that help me finish the visit instead of creating homework after clinic.
